DeterminationBasis: T16-001 establishes the general claim ceiling: a material claim SHALL NOT outrun what its evidence establishes. This directly prevents integrity evidence from being inflated into unsupported truth, authority, correctness, safety, execution, consequence or conformance claims. T16-003 independently exercises the external-status subset by rejecting unsupported representations such as external certification, independent verification, production proof, regulator approval or industry adoption unless the required evidence exists. Together they establish the bounded integrity-evidence claim discipline required by CLAIM-007.

T16-007 verifies completeness of the requirements matrix for an already declared claimed conformance profile. It does not require the conformance claim itself to identify the exact standard version and the specific conformance profile relied upon. T16-001 bounds general claim scope and evidence but likewise does not establish exact standard-version/profile identification. CLAIM-008 therefore remains a distinct conformance-claim identity obligation.
